installCommand: test -f mineral-classifier-app/frontend/package.json || (echo 'BUILD ABORTED: mineral-classifier-app/frontend/package.json not found from the build directory. The Vercel Root Directory must be the REPOSITORY ROOT - Settings > General > Root Directory, leave it EMPTY and redeploy. Pointing it at frontend/ or backend/ also drops api/ and data/ from the deployment.' && exit 1) && npm --prefix mineral-classifier-app/frontend install
buildCommand: npm --prefix mineral-classifier-app/frontend run build && npm --prefix mineral-classifier-app/frontend run verify:dist
